cond_0001.intro: Under general direction of the Biotechnology/Virology Discipline head, supervises and manages the routine diagnostic testing and high-impact disease response testing, quality management, and related activities for the [Company name masked] Biotechnology section. Provides routine consultation, training, quality management, and technical support to Biotechnology staff at three remote branch locations. Responsibilities include molecular diagnostic evaluation of clinical specimens; supervision, management and training of technical staff in the [Location masked] Biotechnology and BSL-3 laboratories; biotechnology testing consultation and technical support to three branch laboratories; participation in trouble-shooting diagnostic assay performance, development, validation, and implementation of new/improved techniques and approaches for enhanced testing efficiency; and independent evaluation/implementation of assays and reagents for improvement of current diagnostic services. This is not a research position. The position is located in a high-throughput diagnostic laboratory where quality control, quality assurance, time-management and meticulous working habits are essential.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Advanced degree in Biology, Animal Science, or closely related fields or equivalent combination of education and experience in a related field.
Demonstrated experience providing effective management and supervision in a diagnostic or accredited facility, including prioritizing workload, scheduling multilevel technical staff to meet strict deadlines with high-volume testing numbers, and assessing and managing workflow efficiency; as well as experience recruiting, hiring, training, evaluating employee performance, and performing conflict resolution, corrective action, mentoring and coaching for staff supervised.
Experience with quality control/quality assurance and safety methods in an accredited laboratory that utilizes complex methodology, maintaining accurate inventory and quality control records for biological media/reagents, developing, implementing, and critically evaluating performance, resolving technical problems related to molecular diagnostic/virology methods, and methods of containment, decontamination, and disposal of infectious and biohazardous materials.
Knowledge in veterinary infectious diseases, virology, nucleic acid sequence evaluation and molecular diagnostics, and performing PCR testing and troubleshooting molecular diagnostics procedures and automated instrumentation in a diagnostic environment or accredited facility.
Skills to perform complex diagnostic and assay development techniques utilizing molecular biology and virology for a high-throughput testing laboratory.
Experience working in BSL-2 and/or BSL-3 facilities.
Preferred Requirements
Technical expertise in PCR, molecular diagnostic assay, and sequencing methods.
National Animal Health Laboratory Network proficiency demonstrated (has passed or ability to pass check tests).
Experience working in an accredited laboratory including quality assurance and quality control.

Responsibilities include molecular diagnostic evaluation of clinical specimens; supervision, management and training of technical staff in the [Location masked] Biotechnology and BSL-3 laboratories; biotechnology testing consultation and technical support to three branch laboratories; participation in trouble-shooting diagnostic assay performance, development, validation, and implementation of new/improved techniques and approaches for enhanced testing efficiency; and independent evaluation/implementation of assays and reagents for improvement of current diagnostic services. This is not a research position. The position is located in a high-through diagnostic laboratory where quality control, quality assurance, time-management and meticulous working habits are essential. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of molecular diagnostic workflows and how the different parts of the testing process fit together.
cond_0031.requirements:
Advanced degree in Biology, Animal Science, or closely related fields or equivalent combination of education and experience in related field.
Demonstrated experience to provide effective management and supervision in a diagnostic or accredited facility including prioritizing workload, scheduling multilevel technical staff to meet strict deadlines with a high-volume testing numbers, assessing and managing workflow efficiency; as well as experience to recruit, hire, train, evaluate the performance of employees, encourage staff development and perform conflict resolution, corrective action, mentoring and coaching for staff supervised.
Experience with quality control/quality assurance and safety methods in an accredited laboratory that utilizes complex methodology, maintaining accurate inventory, quality control records for biological media/reagents, developing, implementing, critically evaluating performance, resolving technical problems related to molecular diagnostic/virology methods, and methods of containment, decontamination, and disposal of infectious and biohazardous materials.
Knowledge in the field of veterinary infectious diseases, virology, nucleic acid sequence evaluation and molecular diagnostics and performing, PCR testing and troubleshooting molecular diagnostics procedures and automated instrumentation in a diagnostic environment or accredited facility.
Skills to performing complex diagnostic and assay development techniques utilizing molecular Biology, virology, for a high through-put testing laboratory.
Experience of technical expertise in PCR, Molecular diagnostic assay, and Sequencing methods.
National Animal Health Laboratory Network proficiency demonstrated (has passed or ability to pass check tests).
Experience working in BSL2 and/or BSL3 facilities.
Experience in working in an accredited laboratory including quality assurance and quality control.
SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS
Background Check
This position is a critical position and subject to a background check. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of background investigation including criminal history and identity checks.

Provides routine consultation, training, quality management, and technical support to Biotechnology staff at three remote branch locations. Responsibilities include molecular diagnostic evaluation of clinical specimens; supervision, management and training of technical staff in the [Location masked] Biotechnology and BSL-3 laboratories; biotechnology testing consultation and technical support to three branch laboratories; participation in trouble-shooting diagnostic assay performance, development, validation, and implementation of new/improved techniques and approaches for enhanced testing efficiency; and independent evaluation/implementation of assays and reagents for improvement of current diagnostic services. This is not a research position. The position is located in a high-through diagnostic laboratory where quality control, quality assurance, time-management and meticulous working habits are essential. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of molecular diagnostic workflows and how the different parts of the testing process fit together.
cond_0103.requirements:
Advanced degree in Biology, Animal Science, or closely related fields or equivalent combination of education and experience in related field.
Demonstrated experience to provide effective management and supervision in a diagnostic or accredited facility including prioritizing workload, scheduling multilevel technical staff to meet strict deadlines with a high-volume testing numbers, assessing and managing workflow efficiency; as well as experience to recruit, hire, train, evaluate the performance of employees, encourage staff development and perform conflict resolution, corrective action, mentoring and coaching for staff supervised.
Experience with quality control/quality assurance and safety methods in an accredited laboratory that utilizes complex methodology, maintaining accurate inventory, quality control records for biological media/reagents, developing, implementing, critically evaluating performance, resolving technical problems related to molecular diagnostic/virology methods, and methods of containment, decontamination, and disposal of infectious and biohazardous materials.
Knowledge in the field of veterinary infectious diseases, virology, nucleic acid sequence evaluation and molecular diagnostics and performing, PCR testing and troubleshooting molecular diagnostics procedures and automated instrumentation in a diagnostic environment or accredited facility.
Skills to performing complex diagnostic and assay development techniques utilizing molecular Biology, virology, for a high through-put testing laboratory.
Experience of technical expertise in PCR, Molecular diagnostic assay, and Sequencing methods.
National Animal Health Laboratory Network proficiency demonstrated (has passed or ability to pass check tests).
Experience working in BSL2 and/or BSL3 facilities.
Experience in working in an accredited laboratory including quality assurance and quality control.
SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS

Responsibilities include molecular diagnostic evaluation of clinical specimens; supervision, management and training of technical staff in the [Location masked] Biotechnology and BSL-3 laboratories; biotechnology testing consultation and technical support to three branch laboratories; participation in trouble-shooting diagnostic assay performance, development, validation, and implementation of new/improved techniques and approaches for enhanced testing efficiency; and independent evaluation/implementation of assays and reagents for improvement of current diagnostic services. This is not a research position. The position is located in a high-through diagnostic laboratory where quality control, quality assurance, time-management and meticulous working habits are essential.
cond_0155.requirements:
Advanced degree in Biology, Animal Science, or closely related fields required; advanced degree strongly preferred over equivalent combinations of education and experience.
Proven track record of effective management and supervision in a diagnostic or accredited facility, including prioritizing workload, scheduling multilevel technical staff to meet strict deadlines with high-volume testing numbers, and assessing and managing workflow efficiency; as well as demonstrated expertise in recruiting, hiring, training, evaluating employee performance, and carrying out staff development, conflict resolution, corrective action, mentoring, and coaching.
Extensive experience with quality control/quality assurance and safety methods in an accredited laboratory utilizing complex methodology, including maintaining accurate inventory and quality control records for biological media/reagents, developing and implementing molecular diagnostic/virology methods, critically evaluating performance, resolving technical problems, and applying methods of containment, decontamination, and disposal of infectious and biohazardous materials.
Advanced knowledge in veterinary infectious diseases, virology, nucleic acid sequence evaluation, and molecular diagnostics, including deep expertise in performing PCR testing and troubleshooting molecular diagnostic procedures and automated instrumentation in a diagnostic or accredited facility.
Strong command of complex diagnostic and assay development techniques utilizing molecular biology and virology in a high-throughput testing laboratory.
Demonstrated expertise in PCR, molecular diagnostic assay development, and sequencing methods.
National Animal Health Laboratory Network proficiency demonstrated (has passed or ability to pass check tests).
Substantial experience working in BSL-2 and/or BSL-3 facilities.
Significant experience working in an accredited laboratory, with deep knowledge of quality assurance and quality control requirements.
SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS

Responsibilities include molecular diagnostic evaluation of clinical specimens; supervision, management and training of technical staff in the [Location masked] Biotechnology and BSL-3 laboratories; biotechnology testing consultation and technical support to three branch laboratories; participation in trouble-shooting diagnostic assay performance, development, validation, and implementation of new/improved techniques and approaches for enhanced testing efficiency; and independent evaluation/implementation of assays and reagents for improvement of current diagnostic services. This is not a research position. The position is located in a high-through diagnostic laboratory where quality control, quality assurance, time-management and meticulous working habits are essential.
cond_0165.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Advanced degree in Biology, Animal Science, or closely related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience in a related field.
Experience managing and supervising staff in a diagnostic or accredited facility, including scheduling multilevel technical staff, prioritizing workload to meet deadlines, and managing workflow efficiency; along with experience in hiring, training, evaluating performance, and supporting staff development, conflict resolution, and corrective action.
Experience with quality control and quality assurance in an accredited laboratory using complex methodology, including maintaining accurate inventory and QC records, evaluating assay performance, resolving technical problems related to molecular diagnostic or virology methods, and handling infectious and biohazardous materials safely.
Background in veterinary infectious diseases, virology, nucleic acid sequence evaluation, and molecular diagnostics, including PCR testing and troubleshooting molecular diagnostic procedures and automated instrumentation in a diagnostic or accredited setting.
Experience working in BSL-2 and/or BSL-3 facilities.
National Animal Health Laboratory Network proficiency demonstrated, or ability to pass check tests.
Preferred Requirements
Familiarity with complex diagnostic and assay development techniques using molecular biology and virology in a high-throughput testing environment.
Working knowledge of PCR, molecular diagnostic assay development, and sequencing methods.
Experience in an accredited laboratory with a focus on quality assurance and quality control practices.
SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS

cond_0221.intro: Under general direction of the Biotechnology/Virology Discipline head, supervises and manages the routine diagnostic testing and high-impact disease response testing, quality management, and related activities for the [Company name masked] Biotechnology section. Provides routine consultation, training, quality management, and technical support to Biotechnology staff at three remote branch locations. Responsibilities include molecular diagnostic evaluation of clinical specimens; supervision, management and training of technical staff in the [Location masked] Biotechnology and BSL-3 laboratories; biotechnology testing consultation and technical support to three branch laboratories; participation in trouble-shooting diagnostic assay performance, development, validation, and implementation of new/improved techniques and approaches for enhanced testing efficiency; and independent evaluation/implementation of assays and reagents for improvement of current diagnostic services. This is not a research position. The position is located in a high-throughput diagnostic laboratory where quality control, quality assurance, time-management and meticulous working habits are essential. People generally become stronger in molecular diagnostics and laboratory management over time as they build experience and learn from the work.
cond_0221.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Advanced degree in Biology, Animal Science, or closely related fields or equivalent combination of education and experience in a related field.
Demonstrated experience providing effective management and supervision in a diagnostic or accredited facility, including prioritizing workload, scheduling multilevel technical staff to meet strict deadlines with high-volume testing numbers, and assessing and managing workflow efficiency; as well as experience recruiting, hiring, training, evaluating employee performance, and performing conflict resolution, corrective action, mentoring and coaching for staff supervised.
Experience with quality control/quality assurance and safety methods in an accredited laboratory that utilizes complex methodology, maintaining accurate inventory and quality control records for biological media/reagents, developing, implementing, and critically evaluating performance, resolving technical problems related to molecular diagnostic/virology methods, and methods of containment, decontamination, and disposal of infectious and biohazardous materials.
Knowledge in the field of veterinary infectious diseases, virology, nucleic acid sequence evaluation and molecular diagnostics, and performing PCR testing and troubleshooting molecular diagnostics procedures and automated instrumentation in a diagnostic environment or accredited facility.
Experience working in BSL2 and/or BSL3 facilities.
Preferred Requirements
Skills in performing complex diagnostic and assay development techniques utilizing molecular biology and virology for a high-throughput testing laboratory.
Technical expertise in PCR, molecular diagnostic assay, and sequencing methods.
National Animal Health Laboratory Network proficiency demonstrated (has passed or ability to pass check tests).
Experience in working in an accredited laboratory including quality assurance and quality control.

Responsibilities include molecular diagnostic evaluation of clinical specimens; supervision, management and training of technical staff in the [Location masked] Biotechnology and BSL-3 laboratories; biotechnology testing consultation and technical support to three branch laboratories; participation in trouble-shooting diagnostic assay performance, development, validation, and implementation of new/improved techniques and approaches for enhanced testing efficiency; and independent evaluation/implementation of assays and reagents for improvement of current diagnostic services. This is not a research position. The position is located in a high-through diagnostic laboratory where quality control, quality assurance, time-management and meticulous working habits are essential. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of molecular diagnostic workflows and how the different parts of the testing process fit together.
cond_0301.requirements:
Advanced degree in Biology, Animal Science, or closely related fields or equivalent combination of education and experience in related field.
Demonstrated experience to provide effective management and supervision in a diagnostic or accredited facility including prioritizing workload, scheduling multilevel technical staff to meet strict deadlines with a high-volume testing numbers, assessing and managing workflow efficiency; as well as experience to recruit, hire, train, evaluate the performance of employees, encourage staff development and perform conflict resolution, corrective action, mentoring and coaching for staff supervised.
Experience with quality control/quality assurance and safety methods in an accredited laboratory that utilizes complex methodology, maintaining accurate inventory, quality control records for biological media/reagents, developing, implementing, critically evaluating performance, resolving technical problems related to molecular diagnostic/virology methods, and methods of containment, decontamination, and disposal of infectious and biohazardous materials.
Knowledge in the field of veterinary infectious diseases, virology, nucleic acid sequence evaluation and molecular diagnostics and performing, PCR testing and troubleshooting molecular diagnostics procedures and automated instrumentation in a diagnostic environment or accredited facility.
Skills to performing complex diagnostic and assay development techniques utilizing molecular Biology, virology, for a high through-put testing laboratory.
Experience of technical expertise in PCR, Molecular diagnostic assay, and Sequencing methods.
National Animal Health Laboratory Network proficiency demonstrated (has passed or ability to pass check tests).
Experience working in BSL2 and/or BSL3 facilities.
Experience in working in an accredited laboratory including quality assurance and quality control.
SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS
Background Check
This position is a critical position and subject to a background check. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of background investigation including criminal history and identity checks.

cond_0301.values: We value excellence in execution and a clear focus on results. We aim to produce work that reflects high standards and a strong commitment to performance.

Advanced degree in Biology, Animal Science, or closely related fields, or equivalent combination of education and experience in a related field.

Experience with quality control/quality assurance and safety methods in an accredited laboratory using complex methodology, including maintaining accurate inventory and quality control records for biological media/reagents, developing and implementing molecular diagnostic/virology methods, and managing containment, decontamination, and disposal of infectious and biohazardous materials.
Knowledge of veterinary infectious diseases, virology, nucleic acid sequence evaluation, and molecular diagnostics, including PCR testing and troubleshooting molecular diagnostic procedures and automated instrumentation in a diagnostic or accredited facility.
Technical expertise in PCR, molecular diagnostic assay, and sequencing methods.
Experience working in BSL-2 and/or BSL-3 facilities.

Responsibilities include directing molecular diagnostic evaluation of clinical specimens; managing and training technical staff in the [Location masked] Biotechnology and BSL-3 laboratories; delivering biotechnology testing consultation and technical support to three branch laboratories; driving trouble-shooting of diagnostic assay performance, development, validation, and implementation of new/improved techniques and approaches for enhanced testing efficiency; and independently evaluating and implementing assays and reagents to improve current diagnostic services. The position is based in a high-throughput diagnostic laboratory where quality control, quality assurance, time-management, and meticulous working habits are essential.

Lead consultation, training, and technical support to Biotechnology staff at three remote branch locations.

Manage, train, and develop technical staff in the Biotechnology and BSL-3 laboratories.
Deliver biotechnology testing consultation and technical support to three branch laboratories.
Drive troubleshooting of diagnostic assay performance and resolve technical problems.
Execute development, validation, and implementation of new and improved diagnostic techniques and approaches.
Independently evaluate and implement assays and reagents to improve current diagnostic services.
cond_0323.requirements:
Advanced degree in Biology, Animal Science, or closely related fields or equivalent combination of education and experience in related field.

Experience with quality control/quality assurance and safety methods in an accredited laboratory using complex methodology, including maintaining accurate inventory and quality control records for biological media/reagents, and methods of containment, decontamination, and disposal of infectious and biohazardous materials.

cond_0451.intro: Under general direction of the Biotechnology/Virology Discipline head, supervises and manages the routine diagnostic testing and high-impact disease response testing, quality management, and related activities for the [Company name masked] Biotechnology section. Provides routine consultation, training, quality management, and technical support to Biotechnology staff at three remote branch locations. Responsibilities include molecular diagnostic evaluation of clinical specimens; supervision, management and training of technical staff in the [Location masked] Biotechnology and BSL-3 laboratories; biotechnology testing consultation and technical support to three branch laboratories; participation in trouble-shooting diagnostic assay performance, development, validation, and implementation of new/improved techniques and approaches for enhanced testing efficiency; and independent evaluation/implementation of assays and reagents for improvement of current diagnostic services. This is not a research position. The position is located in a high-throughput diagnostic laboratory where quality control, quality assurance, time-management and meticulous working habits are essential.
cond_0451.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Advanced degree in Biology, Animal Science, or closely related fields or equivalent combination of education and experience in a related field.
Demonstrated experience providing effective management and supervision in a diagnostic or accredited facility, including prioritizing workload, scheduling multilevel technical staff to meet strict deadlines with high-volume testing numbers, and assessing and managing workflow efficiency; as well as experience recruiting, hiring, training, evaluating employee performance, and performing conflict resolution, corrective action, mentoring and coaching for staff supervised.
Experience with quality control/quality assurance and safety methods in an accredited laboratory that utilizes complex methodology, maintaining accurate inventory and quality control records for biological media/reagents, developing, implementing, and critically evaluating performance, resolving technical problems related to molecular diagnostic/virology methods, and methods of containment, decontamination, and disposal of infectious and biohazardous materials.
Knowledge in veterinary infectious diseases, virology, nucleic acid sequence evaluation and molecular diagnostics, and performing PCR testing and troubleshooting molecular diagnostics procedures and automated instrumentation in a diagnostic environment or accredited facility.
Skills to perform complex diagnostic and assay development techniques utilizing molecular biology and virology for a high-throughput testing laboratory.
Experience working in BSL-2 and/or BSL-3 facilities.
Preferred Requirements
Technical expertise in PCR, molecular diagnostic assay, and sequencing methods.
National Animal Health Laboratory Network proficiency demonstrated (has passed or ability to pass check tests).
Experience working in an accredited laboratory including quality assurance and quality control.
SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS
Background Check
This position is a critical position and subject to a background check. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of background investigation including criminal history and identity checks.
